q20003.en: The sign shown is a parking regulation.

explain.short: The sign says when you may park and when you may not: it regulates parking.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'regolazione della sosta' (parking regulation) is right: it sets parking hours.

sceneParams.caption: A sign that regulates parking by hours

q20004.en: The sign shown allows parking from 9.00 to 17.00.

explain.short: Next to the P you read 9.00-17.00: in those hours parking is allowed.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 9.00 alle 17.00' is right: it is written next to the P.

sceneParams.caption: Parking allowed 9.00-17.00

q20005.en: The sign shown forbids parking from 17.00 to 20.00.

explain.short: Next to the no-parking disc you read 17.00-20.00: in those hours parking is banned.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 17.00 alle 20.00' is right: it is next to the no-parking disc.

sceneParams.caption: No parking 17.00-20.00

q20006.en: The sign shown allows parking at some hours and forbids it at others.

explain.short: The sign has two parts: hours with no parking (top) and hours with parking allowed (bottom).
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'in alcune ore... in altre' (at some hours... at others) describes the two parts.

sceneParams.caption: Some hours yes, others no

q20007.en: The sign shown allows parking from 20.00 to 7.00.

explain.short: Next to the P you read 20.00-7.00: parking is allowed overnight.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 20.00 alle ore 7.00' is right: it is next to the P.

sceneParams.caption: Parking allowed 20.00-7.00

q20008.en: The sign shown forbids parking from 7.00 to 9.00.

explain.short: Next to the no-parking disc you read 7.00-9.00: in those hours parking is banned.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 7.00 alle ore 9.00' is right: it is next to the no-parking disc.

sceneParams.caption: No parking 7.00-9.00

q20009.en: The sign shown, in built-up areas, allows parking from 20.00 to 8.00.

explain.short: Parking is allowed only until 7.00: from 7.00 to 9.00 it is banned. The 8.00 is invented.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'alle 8.00' is the trap: the sign says 20.00-7.00, not until 8.00.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: parking ends at 7.00, not 8.00

q20010.en: The sign shown indicates an area meant for parking using the parking disc.

explain.short: There is no clock symbol: nothing asks you to show a parking disc (disco orario). It only gives hours.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'disco orario' (parking disc) is not on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no parking disc is required

q20011.en: The sign shown forbids the vehicle to stop between 17.00 and 20.00.

explain.short: The disc with one bar bans parking, not stopping. A short stop is allowed at any hour.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'fermata' (stop) is the trap: the sign bans 'sosta' (parking).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it bans parking, not stopping

q20012.en: The sign shown allows parking from 7.00 to 9.00.

explain.short: 7.00-9.00 is next to the no-parking disc: in those hours parking is banned, not allowed.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) is wrong: 7.00-9.00 is a no-parking time.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: 7.00-9.00 is no parking

q20013.en: In the hours when parking is banned, the sign shown means the vehicle will be towed away.

explain.short: Tow-away is shown with an extra tow-truck symbol. This sign has none, so it does not announce tow-away.
explain.rule: No parking 7.00-9.00 and 17.00-20.00; parking allowed 9.00-17.00 and 20.00-7.00. Stopping is always allowed.
explain.trap: 'rimozione' (tow-away) is not on the sign: there is no tow-truck symbol.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no tow-truck symbol, no tow-away

keywords.it: ore in cui è vietata la sosta

q20014.en: The sign shown is a TEMPORARY NO PARKING sign.

explain.short: The no-parking disc applies only on the days and hours written below it, so the ban is temporary.
explain.rule: Temporary no parking for street cleaning: on the days and hours shown, no vehicle may park, so the sweeper can clean.
explain.trap: 'TEMPORANEO' (temporary): the ban applies only at the times shown.

sceneParams.caption: No parking only on the days and hours shown

q20015.en: The sign shown is placed on stretches of road where machine street cleaning is carried out.

explain.short: The drawing of a street sweeper shows why the ban exists: the road is cleaned by machine.
explain.rule: Temporary no parking for street cleaning: on the days and hours shown, no vehicle may park, so the sweeper can clean.
explain.trap: 'pulizia meccanica' (machine cleaning) is what the sweeper drawing means.

sceneParams.caption: Placed where the street sweeper cleans

q20016.en: The sign shown forbids parking during the times when the street is cleaned by machine.

explain.short: Parked cars would block the sweeper, so parking is banned while cleaning takes place.
explain.rule: Temporary no parking for street cleaning: on the days and hours shown, no vehicle may park, so the sweeper can clean.
explain.trap: 'nei periodi' (during the times): the ban is only for the cleaning times.

sceneParams.caption: No parking while the sweeper works

q20017.en: The sign shown, in urban centres, signals a no-parking ban limited to the days and hours shown.

explain.short: The ban applies only on the days (Mon-Fri) and hours (21.00-4.00) written on the sign.
explain.rule: Temporary no parking for street cleaning: on the days and hours shown, no vehicle may park, so the sweeper can clean.
explain.trap: 'limitato' (limited) is right: outside those times you may park.

sceneParams.caption: Ban only Mon-Fri, 21.00-4.00

q20018.en: The sign shown indicates snowploughs working on the road.

explain.short: The vehicle drawn is a street sweeper for cleaning, not a snowplough.
explain.rule: Temporary no parking for street cleaning: on the days and hours shown, no vehicle may park, so the sweeper can clean.
explain.trap: 'sgombraneve' (snowplough) is wrong: it is a cleaning machine.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is a street sweeper

q20019.en: The sign shown says that, in the hours shown, NO PARKING applies to the vehicles drawn.

explain.short: The ban is for ALL vehicles. The drawing shows the sweeper only to explain why.
explain.rule: Temporary no parking for street cleaning: on the days and hours shown, no vehicle may park, so the sweeper can clean.
explain.trap: 'per i veicoli rappresentati' (for the vehicles drawn) is wrong: the sweeper is the reason, not the target.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the ban is for all vehicles

q20020.en: The sign shown means that on the days and hours shown, cleaning vehicles may not park.

explain.short: It is the other way round: the other vehicles may not park, so the cleaning vehicles can work.
explain.rule: Temporary no parking for street cleaning: on the days and hours shown, no vehicle may park, so the sweeper can clean.
explain.trap: 'ai mezzi di pulizia' (to cleaning vehicles) turns the meaning upside down.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: others may not park, the sweeper works

keywords.it: nei giorni e nelle ore indicate
keywords.en: on the days and hours shown

q20021.en: The sign shown indicates a depot from which street-cleaning vehicles may come out.

explain.short: The sign bans parking during cleaning; it does not warn about a depot.
explain.rule: Temporary no parking for street cleaning: on the days and hours shown, no vehicle may park, so the sweeper can clean.
explain.trap: 'deposito' (depot) is invented: the sign is a parking ban.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is a parking ban, not a depot

q20022.en: The sign shown forbids road trains and articulated lorries to pass.

explain.short: The red-bordered disc means no entry, and the drawings below say for whom: lorries with trailers and articulated lorries.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'autotreni' (lorry + trailer) and 'autoarticolati' (tractor + semi-trailer) are the two drawings.

sceneParams.caption: No entry for road trains and articulated lorries

q20023.en: Where the sign shown is present, the categories of vehicles drawn may not pass.

explain.short: The ban applies to the vehicles drawn under the disc.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'rappresentati in figura' (drawn in the picture): the drawings name who is banned.

sceneParams.caption: The vehicles drawn may not pass

q20024.en: The sign shown is a no-entry for certain categories of vehicles.

explain.short: It does not close the road to everyone: only to the vehicles drawn.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'determinate categorie' (certain categories) is right: only some vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: No entry only for some vehicles

q20025.en: The sign shown means that vehicles of the categories drawn may not pass.

explain.short: The vehicles drawn under the disc are the ones that may not go on.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'non possono transitare' (may not pass) is right for the vehicles drawn.

sceneParams.caption: The vehicles drawn may not pass

q20026.en: The sign shown means that all vehicles may pass except those of the categories drawn.

explain.short: Only the drawn vehicles are banned; cars, vans, motorbikes and all others may pass.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'esclusi' (except) is right: everyone may pass except the vehicles drawn.

sceneParams.caption: All may pass, except the vehicles drawn

q20027.en: The sign shown indicates a compulsory route for motor vehicles of the categories drawn.

explain.short: A red-bordered disc is a ban, not an order to go a certain way. Compulsory routes use blue signs.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'itinerario obbligatorio' (compulsory route) is wrong: it is a ban.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is a ban, not a compulsory route

q20028.en: The sign shown announces a car park for lorries and road trains.

explain.short: There is no P on the sign: the red-bordered disc bans these vehicles from passing.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'parcheggio' (car park) is wrong: it is a no-entry sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it bans them, no car park

q20029.en: The sign shown forbids all vehicles to pass, except those drawn.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the drawn vehicles are the banned ones; all others may pass.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'con esclusione di quelli rappresentati' turns the meaning upside down.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the drawn vehicles are the banned ones

q20030.en: The sign shown forbids road trains and articulated lorries to park.

explain.short: A white disc with a red border bans passing (transito), not parking. No parking has a blue disc with a red bar.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'sosta' (parking) is wrong: the sign bans 'transito' (passing).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it bans passing, not parking

q20031.en: The sign shown indicates a no-parking ban for road trains and articulated lorries.

explain.short: A white disc with a red border bans passing, not parking. No parking has a blue disc with a red bar.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'divieto di sosta' (no parking) is wrong: this is 'divieto di transito' (no entry).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it bans passing, not parking

q20032.en: The sign shown warns of a road reserved for the vehicles of the categories drawn.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the vehicles drawn may NOT use this road. It is a ban, not a reservation.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' for the vehicles drawn: road trains and articulated lorries may not pass; all other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'riservata' (reserved) is wrong: the drawn vehicles are banned.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the drawn vehicles are banned
